content.title: Cragrock Tower
content.body:
A note I found, written by someone else in the past:

"Holy... what is this? There was this massive tower that I found, and as foreboding as it looked, I figured it could be a place to settle down for a while to figure out what to do.

Not a chance. The ghosts were in tremendous numbers. They flew through the walls before I could take a step into that place, and I was out of there in an instant.

It seemed to be a pretty major landmark, and I'm sure it had great loot, but... I can't do this anymore.

I thought this would be an exciting search, but it's turning into absolute horror. I'm completely unwelcome anywhere here. I have to find a way out, before I go mad."
